properties.description: The queries in this script are used for data profiling and deciding best data types for calendar data

content.query:
SELECT
 *
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'L_TIME.csv',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'USOnTimeProject_Lookup',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE
    )
    WITH (
        TimeSKey        SMALLINT,
        TimeKey         SMALLINT,
        TimeValue       TIME(0),
        Time_24_Hour    VARCHAR(10),
        Time_12_Hour    VARCHAR(10),
        HourNumber      TINYINT,
        MinuteNumber    TINYINT,
        PartOfDay       VARCHAR(10),
        TimeBucket      VARCHAR(20)
    ) AS [TIME]

--Record Count - 1440




    EXEC sp_describe_first_result_set N'SELECT
     *
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK ''https://adlsusontimeproject.dfs.core.windows.net/fsusontimeproject/Lookup/L_TIME.csv'',
        FORMAT = ''CSV'',
        PARSER_VERSION = ''2.0'',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE
    ) AS [TIME]'
